semantic.justification: Iteration104 adapts the bounded ordinary SvxStyleBox client acceptance contract: direct picks and Enter resolve actual entries then focus the owning active Writer document before existing StyleApply dispatch; closed Arrow/Page travel is tentative, Tab accepts without focus release, Escape cancels and releases focus, and blur or replaced bindings/options invalidate drafts. Actual frame cursor/mark, raw custom names, history/no-op, document replacement and modal/inactive eligibility are covered by independent owned widget/frame tests and desktop/mobile ODT scenarios. Editable/new style creation, Clear/More actions, previews/context menus, full popup/platform behavior and wider native/widget/parent parity remain unverified. No status/default/exception promotion; registered save/open/recovery deviations unchanged.
